text: The Jinan municipal State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission holds 93.19% of Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group and is its largest shareholder and actual controller; Shandong Caixin Asset Operation Co., Ltd. holds 6.81%.
short: Jinan SASAC holds 93.19% of Jinan Culture & Tourism Group and controls it.

source.name: 搜狐/金融界 (Sohu / JRJ.com, via 经济导报 Economic Herald): 济南文旅集团换帅！总经理王学军接任法定代表人，白冰退出董事长岗位
source.quote: 股权结构显示，公司大股东、实际控制人济南市国资委持股93.19%；山东省财欣资产运营有限公司持股6.81%。
source.note: Translation: 'The shareholding structure shows the company's largest shareholder and actual controller, the Jinan Municipal SASAC, holds 93.19%; Shandong Caixin Asset Operation Co., Ltd. holds 6.81%.' The article cites the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and the Economic Herald (经济导报).

additionalSources.quote: 股权结构显示，公司大股东、实际控制人济南市国资委持股93.19%；山东省财欣资产运营有限公司持股6.81%。
additionalSources.note: Translation as for the Sohu source; the same Shandong Business Report (山东财经报道) copy carried by The Paper's media channel.

additionalSources.name: 山东人才就业网 (Shandong Talent Employment Network): 2026年济南文旅发展集团有限公司校园招聘公告（20人）
additionalSources.quote: 济南文旅发展集团有限公司(以下简称集团)是济南市政府2017年6月批准设立的市属一级国有企业
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group Co., Ltd. (the Group) is a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise established with the approval of the Jinan municipal government in June 2017.'
